# Workflows

Default target: Clay

## Targets

### Clay

Author, run, publish, and inspect through target-sandbox/clay/state.json. Data and runs live in Clay. Connections live in-app and credits are estimated.

### Local

Author tracked TypeScript, run once, and inspect locally. No separate publish. SQLite and outputs are ignored. Credentials use pointers and provider costs are estimated.
